name: Chi Yin PLUS -Bu Cunzai de Shengdan Jie-
source:
This is a story about her and him. This is also a story about meeting and parting. Perhaps it is a very simple story. It may be a very complicated story. A simple FAREWELL ...... And not a grand farewell. If you can feel the joy and sorrow we pour in, it is a great encouragement to us.

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/740260/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这是一个关于她和他的故事。这也是一个关于相遇和离别的故事。也许这是一个非常简单的故事。这可能是一个非常复杂的故事。一次简单的告别……而不是一场盛​​大的告别。如果你能感受到我们倾注的喜悦和悲伤，这对我们来说是很大的鼓励。

[来自[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/740260/]Steam[/url]]
